run_RottenTomatos_main: run the RottenTomatos dataset preprocessing script to generate k-shot data for multiple random seeds
create_RottenTomatos_instance: create a RottenTomatos classification dataset instance with negative and positive sentiment labels
load_dataset_RottenTomatos: load the rotten_tomatoes HuggingFace dataset using the load_dataset method of RottenTomatos
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace dataset split to a list of text and label tuples using map_hf_dataset_to_list
generate_k_shot_data: generate k-shot train dev and test splits from the RottenTomatos dataset using generate_k_shot_data
